name: Deep Lament
source:
The light shining through the water creates dancing ripples, lines of white and yellow illuminating fishes dancing around in groups, small bodies colliding in search of food. 

What curious creatures they are, accompanying the submarine as it starts to go down, down, down…

[From [url=https://colenico.itch.io/deep-lament]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
穿过水面的光线产生了舞动的涟漪，白色和黄色的发光鱼成群结队地跳舞，小小的身体互相碰撞寻找食物。

它们是多么奇怪的生物啊，伴随着潜艇开始下沉、下沉、下沉……

[来自[url=https://colenico.itch.io/deep-lament]Itch.io[/url]]
